summary: As a Nebraska educator and school librarian, the author urges the FCC to protect the federal E-Rate program and reject cuts that would hurt public schools and libraries. Reliable, secure internet is essential for student learning, research, cybersecurity, and communication with families. Cutting E-Rate will not eliminate these costs; it will shift the burden to local school budgets and taxpayers. Rural, suburban, and urban communities all depend on this support.
